name: Illinois YMCA Youth and Government
city: Springfield, IL (state conference), delegations across Illinois
what_you_do: Join a delegation and take a role in a student model of Illinois state government. Roles include legislator, attorney, lobbyist or press team. You use what you learn at a state conference.
who_can_apply: High school students. Legislative Assistant and Press Team are open to freshmen through seniors. Lobbyist and Attorney are for sophomores to seniors. Legislator is for juniors and seniors. Anyone can be a Clerk-Bailiff.
pay_detail: $455 program fee. Your delegation decides how it is collected (full payment, deposit, or register first). Scholarships are available through the registration application.
duration: School year, ending with a state conference
deadline_text: Closed: the scholarship portal closed October 1, 2026 (decisions come before November 1). Not known: whether you can still register, the conference dates and a general registration deadline are not posted on the page read. Ask your Delegation Advisor or the state office.
how_to_apply: Get the registration link from your local Delegation Advisor. A student and a parent or guardian both sign the code of conduct. You pick a preferred role and give your State Senator and State Representative. Contact the state office if you have no delegation.
notes: Not a job. State office: 1315 Butterfield Rd, Suite 218, Downers Grove, IL 60515, (630) 833-9622, ilyag@ilymcayg.org.
